definition_zh: 作用于轮轨接触法向、由法向压缩变形决定的接触力。
definition_en: The wheel–rail contact-force components acting in the normal direction and related to normal elastic compression.
usage_overview: 在车辆—轨道动力学计算中，用于描述轮轨间的法向接触作用，依据接触点的法向弹性压缩求取；采用Hertz接触理论的模型通过该理论建立压缩量与接触力的关系。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

complete_examples.text: The wheel/rail interaction forces mainly include wheel–rail normal contact forces derived by nonlinear Hertzian elastic contact theory according to the elastic compression deformation of wheels and rails at contact points in the normal directions, and tangential wheel–rail creep forces, which are calculated first by Kalker’s linear creep theory and then modified with the Shen–Hedrick–Elkins nonlinear model [31] .
